title: Densetsu no Stafy
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text:
Health (hearts); Spin attack (B)
First Starfy game (Japan only; English fan translation): Stafy, a star prince of Pufftop, searches the sea kingdom
Health hearts; spinning is both attack and dash

Spin dash, swim, float
Spin attack (B) knocks out enemies and breaks blocks; swimming moves freely in all directions under water
Later abilities from treasure open new paths in earlier stages

Each stage ends in a boss; spin to stun
Every stage ends with a boss: stun it with spins between its attacks
Many bosses have a pattern of three attacks; spin when the pattern ends

Stages across the sea kingdom, each with a boss at the end
Stages of the sea kingdom played in order, each split into areas

Pearls (money), shop items
Pearls are the currency for the shop; items heal or give bonuses

Treasures and costumes
Treasures and costumes hidden in stages

Stages cleared
Stages cleared to the final boss
Each stage has several areas; the boss door is at the end
English translation in the Translations folder; version 4-7-20 (from the file name)
